content:
maria.finance: FYI seeing an unexpected nightly GPU spend drift for west-us2 over the last 3 nights, ~+18% vs baseline. query below, looks like short-lived large instance startups around 03:00. anyone own the autoscaler / batch windows there?

alex.infra: Hmm, could be the nodepool autoscaler reacting to a cron job. i'll check autoscaler events in the logs. cc @ravi.ml in case model eval runners kicked off.

maria.finance: attaching the quick cost sql we ran:```SELECT date_trunc('hour', usage_start) as hour, resource_type, sum(cost) as cost FROM cost_events WHERE region='us-west-2' AND usage_start >= now() - interval '4 days' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 48;```

deploy-bot: [autoscaler] scale event: cluster-prod-west autoscale 6 -> 22 nodes (p4d-large) at 2026-03-20T03:04:12Z. trace: https://ci.internal/scale/ev/98765

ravi.ml: yep we pushed a change to night-runner window last week to speed up evals (moved from 04:00 to 02:55). that could explain surge. we didn't expect node count to spike that high.

maria.finance: we didn't fire budget alerts because current rule is 24h average threshold. that's masking short peaks. can we change alerting to surface 95th pct or hourly spikes? also need to attribute cost to ml-team tag, half of these nodes show up untagged.

alex.infra: agree on alerting. i'll PR an alert change to use 6h 95th-percentile and hourly spike rule. ravi can you revert or throttle concurrency for night-runner until we confirm?

ravi.ml: i'll revert the window tonight and add concurrency cap to the runner (max parallel jobs = 8).

maria.finance: thanks. i'll open a CostOps ticket to reclassify the untagged node charges and request a retro allocation if needed. ticket: CO-2026-142. please add any logs to the ticket.

costops-bot: ticket CO-2026-142 created by maria.finance. assignees: alex.infra, ravi.ml. due date: 2026-03-25.

alex.infra: taking ownership of the alert PR and tagging backfill. will link PR and backfill SQL in the ticket.

maria.finance: perfect. once PR is live, can finance get a 24h test alert to ensure it triggers on similar spikes?

ravi.ml: yes i'll run a dry-run tonight in staging to simulate the spike and confirm alert fires.

maria.finance: great, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
